profile.title: Profile
profile.text: AI Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience building agentic AI systems, computer vision pipelines and full-stack applications. Currently designing AI architectures for Toyota at Silicon Shoring Reply. Skilled in Python, TypeScript, Java and Go across LangChain, PyTorch, YOLO, React and Spring. BSc in Computer Science from the University of Milan.

items.description: Architecting and shipping production agentic AI systems for Toyota — powering AI assistants, enterprise knowledge retrieval and intelligent decision support across core business processes. Built on LangChain and Azure AI Foundry.
Drove adoption of modern, AI-assisted development practices across Stellantis engineering teams, streamlining workflows and accelerating delivery of business-critical solutions.
Sole owner of the backend powering the DAT management system for Regione Lombardia — designed, built and maintained scalable, secure Spring services running a region-wide public-sector platform.

Built a YOLO-based computer vision pipeline that tracks basketball players and generates live box scores from raw game footage, replacing manual stat-keeping. Also delivered agentic AI solutions for clients.
Delivered custom client websites end-to-end — from design to deployment — with React.js and JavaScript while studying full-time.

items.role: Web Scraping & Data Analysis — Argenta S.p.A.
items.description: Built an automated pipeline that scrapes and digitizes PDFs into structured CSV data, replacing manual data entry. Selenium, BeautifulSoup, Pandas.
Led a team to deliver 3 projects end-to-end — CamHouse, BusGlyphs and Authentication Disk — in C# and Windows Forms.
